name: android_wake_screen
description: Wakes up the device screen or puts it into sleep mode. Prefer this dedicated tool over android_press_button (wakeup/sleep) for screen power state.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

wake.description: True to wake screen up, false to put device into sleep mode.
